flood.title: Kaggle Predict the Flood: 20 Features (HW2 Primary Problem)
flood.hero_title: Kaggle S4E5: Flood Probability Prediction (20 Features)
flood.hero_desc: Analyze 30,000 real-world observations across 20 environmental and infrastructural risk features from Kaggle Playground S4E5. Benchmark 5 Feature Selection Algorithms against Baseline OLS to predict FloodProbability.
flood.sweet_spot_note: Parsimony Analysis: All 20 features are orthogonal and non-collinear (Max VIF = 1.006). The full 20-feature OLS achieves peak R² = 0.8445 and lowest test RMSE = 0.01998.
flood.overfitting_note: Consensus Top 14 Sub-model: Achieves R² = 0.5454 and RMSE = 0.03417, demonstrating the value of comprehensive feature retention.

house_prices.title: Kaggle House Prices: Advanced Regression (18 Features, HW2 Secondary Problem)
house_prices.hero_title: Kaggle House Prices: Ames Housing Valuation (18 Features)
house_prices.hero_desc: Analyze 1,460 residential properties across 18 architectural, dimensional, and condition features from the official Kaggle House Prices competition. Benchmark 5 Feature Selection Algorithms against Baseline OLS to predict SalePrice.
house_prices.sweet_spot_note: Occam's Razor: Top 8 features (OverallQual, GrLivArea, GarageCars, TotalBsmtSF, 1stFlrSF, FullBath, TotRmsAbvGrd, YearBuilt) explain over 80% of house price variance.
house_prices.overfitting_note: Full Model (k=18): Achieves lowest overall test RMSE with minor multicollinearity between area variables (GrLivArea vs 1stFlrSF).
